note: Iteration-4 findings (2 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 NIT) were resolved by the orchestrator directly in design.md after the design loop exhausted its iteration budget. The reviewer confirmed all six gate dimensions were already resolved; the remaining items were localized security-rule / offline-ordering specifics, each with a prescribed fix, now applied and documented in design.md PART F. Design is approved to proceed to planning and implementation.

resolvedFindings.title: Offline flush ordering could drop a late set create
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.7 adds an explicit flush barrier: complete-session Step 2 gates on waitForPendingWrites(db) so the COMPLETED flip is strictly last; no parentOpen()-gated create can arrive afterward.

resolvedFindings.title: summaryApplied toggle write mode unspecified vs validSession
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.7 Step 3 specifies a merge update (updateDoc/set merge:true) preserving all fields; validSession evaluates the post-merge document; non-merge partial set() disallowed.

resolvedFindings.title: Second-device toggle denial handling
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.7 Step 3: transaction reads session first and no-ops when already applied; a rules-denied race is treated as success (not retried); toggle carries no baseUpdatedAt precondition.

resolvedFindings.title: ExerciseSession unvalidated; sessionCompleted not stated mandatory at create
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.3/C.9: sessionCompleted:false required at create on ExerciseSession and SetLog (non-optional, service-stamped); validExerciseSession() rule predicate added.

resolvedFindings.title: No-flash routing missed authed-but-profile-loading state
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.2 adds the explicit AuthGuard state machine in authStore.phase; both loading phases render the full-screen loader with no route change; only unauthenticated redirects.

resolvedFindings.title: Key-presence validSet XOR vs null-valued optional
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.4/C.8a: converters omit absent optional keys entirely (conditional spread) and the Firestore app sets ignoreUndefinedProperties:true; actualReps:null is never produced; emulator test asserts both halves.

resolvedFindings.title: parentOpen() get() ceiling
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.9 notes parentOpen()-gated creates are always single-doc writes, one get() per request, far under the 10-get() limit.

resolvedFindings.title: Storage thumbnail generation / non-image artifacts
resolvedFindings.resolution: C.9 storage block: thumbPath thumbnails are client-generated image/* blobs; no server-side image processing; no non-image artifact written to Storage.
